findings.text: blocking: the fragment states the population's enriched_at maximum as 2026-10-13T17:12:54.894Z, which is the pre-repair span (gate-enrichment-census.log, revision 365d497ff); gate-census.log at the cited revision eed4150c1 records hi 2026-11-23T18:43:13.519Z for the same 15,111 rows, and the repaired twenty all carry 2026-11-23 timestamps, so the stated maximum contradicts the receipt the fragment cites.

blocking: "a scan for a numeric identifier ... finds nothing anywhere in the 15,111" overstates the scan's coverage and its tense: the numeric rule in verify_sample.py:30-36 and test_enrichment_gate.py:40 runs only over the 3,879 rows with enrichment_source='direct', no all-population numeric scan is recorded, and on the population as written by the regeneration the same rule returned 16 hits (number-conflict.log), which paragraph 2 of this fragment then describes.

blocking: the screen accounting does not match the run's own logs: number-conflict.log reports 16 hits made of 14 rotated signals plus the two singletons (not 14 plus "the other four"), and batch-leaks.log reports 16 within-batch content leaks of which 11 lie outside the twenty and none is one of the four the numeric screen missed, so "both screens isolate the same twenty signals and flag nothing else" is false as stated.

non-blocking: `assert all(r["description"] for r in sample)` is tautological because the sample is drawn at line 40 from rows filtered `s.description IS NOT NULL AND <> ''`, so it cannot fail; the test name promises that the sample describes its own catalogue text but nothing compares a sampled description with its source_description, and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/jt60sa-discovery-completion-s62.html:79-81 claims both facts are asserted by this gate arm.

justifications.durability: the gate is repeatable and its numeric conflict assertion fails on the pre-repair snapshot (16 conflicts reproduced), but /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261123T153248784550-jt60sa-discovery-completion-s62/test_enrichment_gate.py:56 asserts that sample descriptions are non-empty over rows the query at :40 already filtered to non-empty, so that case cannot fail.
justifications.evidence: the conflicts rule in /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261123T153248784550-jt60sa-discovery-completion-s62/test_enrichment_gate.py:45-53 genuinely fires (a replay of it over enrichment-before-regeneration.jsonl returns 16 conflicts pre-repair and gate-sample.log records 0 post-repair), but docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/jt60sa-discovery-completion-s62.html:6-7, :11-13 and :41-45 misstate the population span, the scan's coverage and the two screens' counts.

justifications.reuse: the change adds documentation only and no definition; the search for an existing owner of JT-60SA enrichment evidence found only the plan section and sibling fragments, so nothing is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 365d497ff..648ced901 lists only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/jt60sa-discovery-completion-s62.html, inside the declared write paths, and the node edits no plan file.
